name: Bitwise Marching Cubes
aliases: Marching Cubes with Bitwise Cube Index Propagation
definition: A surface extraction algorithm that generates a mesh from voxel data by determining the topology of an isosurface within each voxel cube. It uses a bitwise propagation technique to compute the cube index (case number) for the current cell by reusing bits from the previous cell in the X, Y, and Z directions, avoiding redundant voxel lookups for shared corners.
